comments.body: That leaves you with 20 CHF a day. Sorry to say that, bit thats unlivable. Sorry, but that leaves no room for anything non necesarry. Lost you Phone? Nope, cant get a new one, need some new Pants? Nope, not in the budget, want to go eat with Friends? Nope, the Bus ticket to the Restaurant is over your budget, not to mention the Food itself.
comments.author: Pael-eSports
